title: [RFE] Allow disabling proxy for VPN connections
line: The Proxy settings page has a new option to stop using the proxy while a VPN is connected.
explanation: Plasma's proxy settings live in kioslaverc, which libproxy (and through it Qt, KIO workers and many other apps) reads. Nothing looked at whether a VPN was up, so a configured proxy kept being used and traffic meant for the VPN went to the old network's proxy. The Proxy page now has an opt-in "Don't use a proxy while connected to a VPN" checkbox; a new kded module in the same KCM watches NetworkManager and, while a VPN or WireGuard connection is active, sets the proxy type to none and keeps the real type in ProxyTypeWithoutVpn, putting it back when the VPN goes away. The KCM shows and edits the real type during a VPN, so the user's settings never look lost.

commits.message:
kcms/proxy: add an option to not use a proxy while a VPN is connected

The configured proxy stayed in use while connected to a VPN, so traffic
went through the old network's proxy. A new opt-in option and a kded
module now switch to no proxy while NetworkManager has a VPN up.

BUG: 329627

media.caption: Before: manual proxy configured; the page has no VPN-related option
After, with a VPN connected (proxy currently off): the page still shows the real manual proxy, with Apply disabled
Before: bottom of the Proxy page
After: new "Don't use a proxy while connected to a VPN" option, checked
